sentences.en: She had changed so much that I couldn't recognize her.
sentences.zh: 她变化太大了，我都认不出她。

sentences.en: Having met the girl before, I recognized her at once.
sentences.zh: 认识那个女孩之前，我一眼就认出了她。

sentences.en: Quite a few people couldn't recognize him in that disguise.
sentences.zh: 很多人在他那样打扮的时候都认不出他来。

senses.zh: 认出，识别；承认；接受，认可；赞赏
